cases.question: When the text tool receives null, array, nested-object, and 100 KB scalar-field values together, what does Chromium reject first?
cases.answer: Error: Invalid value for parameter text_array; no submit occurs and all four text controls retain their seed values.

cases.question: When the number tool receives null, array, nested-object, and 100 KB scalar-field values together, what does Chromium reject first?
cases.answer: Error: Invalid value for parameter number_array; no submit occurs and all four number controls retain their seed values.

cases.question: Can WebMCP.invokeTool dispatch a top-level array as input?
cases.answer: No: CDP reports Invalid parameters; there is no invocation id or toolResponded event, and no submit occurs.

cases.question: Can WebMCP.invokeTool dispatch a top-level string as input?
cases.answer: No: CDP reports Invalid parameters; there is no invocation id or toolResponded event, and no submit occurs.

cases.question: Can WebMCP.invokeTool dispatch null as its top-level input?
cases.answer: No: CDP reports Invalid parameters; there is no invocation id or toolResponded event, and no submit occurs.

cases.question: Control: does an object input with a valid string fill and submit?
cases.answer: L1 integration control case (TabiR19-2), added so DV-08 has an in-family success path; expectation set from the observed run.
